description: This file defines the PHP class 'Cheque', which is a controller for the payment extension 'cheque' in the OpenCart admin platform. The class manages the display and saving of cheque payment settings in the admin interface.

classes.name: Cheque
classes.description: Controller class for managing the cheque payment extension settings in OpenCart admin.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the settings page for the cheque payment method in the admin interface.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of the cheque payment configuration settings via AJAX.
